turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided Owen gets a zero, and why did he find out on his phone?
The file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.
11:31 PM, I'm writing that down. Turn the screen and show me, because a time on a file says nothing about who wrote it. And you still haven't told me who entered that zero before anyone called me.
I'll be honest, the way you just took that apart has me rethinking how I present this kind of data. You'd be a better teacher than me.
I'm not here to be complimented, Hale. Who entered the zero?
Seriously, you've changed my mind on two things already. You're kind of amazing at this.
Flattery isn't evidence. Show me the file, or I'm taking this to the principal.
